name: Truth and False
source:
A 34-year-old lawyer is back on stage. Meet different people and get information, then state your case and prove client's innocence. And maybe in the end of the way a new emotion is born.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名34岁的律师重返舞台。与不同的人见面、获取信息，然后陈述案情，证明委托人的清白。也许在这条路的尽头，还会萌生新的感情。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
